reviewer.exact_version: unavailable: no snapshot/version identifier beyond the model ID is exposed to the session
reviewer.interface: Claude Code CLI session operated by @kausthubabelagodbdes24-oss
reviewer.method: single model pass over the local text packet (generated text, intended label, exact AugGPT source; re-check also shows the superseded round-1 text); judged against config.yaml label definitions and the ADR 0013 answer-type requirement; no self-consistency voting and no second reviewer. Same model family as the round-1 reviewer and as the implementing agent, so errors may be correlated.

rubric.ambiguous: derived: not a clear error, and label_fit == ambiguous or source_meaning == partially_changed
rubric.clear_error: derived: label_fit == wrong or source_meaning == changed; counts toward the two-error trigger
rubric.copied_demonstration: few-shot only: compared with the row's own three source demonstrations
rubric.label_definitions: config.yaml tasks.<task>.labels (unchanged; annoyance under anger, worry under fear)
rubric.label_fit: fits: clearly the intended label; ambiguous: plausible under the intended label but another label is comparably plausible or the label is under-determined; wrong: clearly a different label
rubric.naturalness: fluency and plausibility as a real question/tweet
rubric.source_meaning: AugGPT only: compared with the exact low-resource source text and label; changed means the meaning or the expressed label changed; partially_changed means details dropped/added but the label and core meaning survive
rubric.style_fit: matches the task/dataset style in config.yaml (TREC short search question; Emotion lower-case first-person tweet)
rubric.template_repetition: repeated_frame when the text reuses an opening/frame that recurs across the artifact with little lexical variation
rubric.trigger: >= 2 clear errors among a batch's 10 -> FLAGGED
